ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~16 day(s) ago @ 103.52) and momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over. A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum curling up; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 7 · daily cycle day 31).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 31 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 7 of a typical 16–26 weeks

cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 7 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 16 天前形成 @ 103.52）且动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量开始上翘；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 7 周 · 日线周期第 31 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近高点。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A HIGH signal just triggered today (fresh cross from BOTTOMING). Signal strength: mild (score -20/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近高点信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自筑底中翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 -20/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: light exit setting up (-32)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱离场构筑中（-32）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+4.8% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +4.8%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -11.3 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -11.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.28 ± 0.22 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLP) reads long-duration (+0.14). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.28 ± 0.22——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLP）为长久期（+0.14）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

detail.en: Mid-range composite and accumulation — no contrarian extension or washout edge here.
detail.zh: 综合分与吸筹均处中位 — 无逆向高位或超卖的边际。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。

decision.headline: Extended — don't chase; wait for a pullback
decision.headline_zh: 过度拉升 — 勿追高；等待回撤
decision.gloss: Ran too far, too fast — don't chase; wait for a dip.
decision.gloss_zh: 涨得太快太远——勿追高；等待回撤。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
timing.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

decision.conflict_note: Top board rank, but timing blocks a buy now — the rank measures the name, not the moment.
decision.conflict_note_zh: 板内排名靠前，但时机阻碍当前买入——排名衡量个股，而非买入时机。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

trend.label: Trend
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 4% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -6% · 极端 -21% · → 建议仓位 0%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.value_zh: 1 家主动基金 · 1 家 13F 持有人 · 减仓中（1→0 家，6季）
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
